title: Golden scenario
description: Reference data for one run of one pipeline. Inputs are scripted; expected events are written out explicitly, never generated. Encodes docs/SPEC.md; behaviour is not implemented here.

covers.description: Rules this scenario actually exercises or constrains.

pipeline.description: Basename of a fixture in spec/pipelines/. Resolution is checked in 05c.

inputs.description: Every scripted observation and operator action, in the order the engine observes them (SPEC R15).

expect.description: The complete expected event sequence. No omissions and no ellipses.

side_effects.description: Expectations events alone cannot express (SPEC R12, R13, R14).

oneOf.title: agent_result_settled
oneOf.description: Completion was established AND turn-attributable text is available (SPEC R4), so text is required. The verdict, if any, is parsed from this text.

oneOf.title: agent_result_without_answer
oneOf.description: 'blocked' is a permission dialog; 'unconfirmed' is a settled lifecycle state with no attributable answer (step 04). Neither carries text, so none is permitted here.

oneOf.title: gate_result
oneOf.description: A gate execution that actually completed. The outcome comes from a real process exit status (SPEC R7); a gate that never exits is expressed as a deadline_expiry instead.

output.description: The command's output. Required, and may be empty: SPEC R7 saves the last lines as a handoff, so a scenario must be able to state those contents exactly. A gate that produced no output scripts an empty string rather than omitting the field.

oneOf.title: guard_observation
oneOf.description: Working-tree comparison against the turn's effective baseline (SPEC R6).

oneOf.title: deadline_expiry
oneOf.description: The turn's observation deadline elapses before a result is observed (SPEC R4, R7, R12).

oneOf.title: operator_action
oneOf.description: A scenario input, never a run-log event (SPEC section 5).
